name: Liquid Death
rundown: Liquid Death is a canned water and iced-tea brand that markets healthy hydration with heavy-metal, horror-movie irreverence. By selling plain water in tallboy cans that look like beer, it turned a boring category into a viral lifestyle brand.

timeline.event: Former ad creative Mike Cessario launches Liquid Death, selling water in tallboy cans.
Rides viral marketing to a valuation above a billion dollars.

notableFacts: It sells still and sparkling water in 'tallboy' cans designed to look like beer.
Its tagline is "Murder Your Thirst," and the brand leans into heavy-metal and horror aesthetics.
It ties its marketing to fighting single-use plastic pollution.
